About Kits Walk by Strand

Kits Walk is move-in ready, book a tour today!


Virtual Appointments available. 

Kits Walk is a limited collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom, rental homes steps from the Arbutus Greenway. Kits Walk offers plenty of west side charm in the heart Kitsilano. From the high-level finishing, contemporary design, building amenities and conveniences, and transit options outside your door, we are excited to show you Kits Walk and help you find your new home.

Features:
• Stylish and sophisticated kitchens featuring quartz countertops, flat-panel wood grain cabinetry and energy efficient stainless steel appliances including a quiet, in-suite Whirlpool washer and dryer
• Spacious closets and in-suite or below grade storage
• Secured state of the art keyless entry
• Private outdoor spaces
• Over height ceilings
• Plenty of natural light

Amenities:
• 24-hour camera surveillance, secured underground parking, and personally coded entry fob
• Electric vehicle parking stalls
• Common lounge, kitchenette, and BBQ
• Outdoor common area with children's play area
• In-building Bike Room with maintenance bench and Dog Wash Station
• Free bike storage
